title: Ken Farley's description of the craft's gold lines

tellings.quote: Ken Farley could still describe the craft in perfect detail. At the end, he said, "And around the center section of the craft, there were three brass or copper or gold lines that ran all the way around it."

plain: Ken Farley, a witness to a craft said to have come down in 1948 in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, could still describe it in perfect detail years later, and at the end he added that "three brass or copper or gold lines" ran all the way around its center section. Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has spent years investigating the Aztec case, tells Michels this as what Farley said, and he also names a man called Doug Noland in connection with the account. It is one of several witness memories Ramsey offers as signs that a real craft lay in that canyon.
